title: Hotel and Travel
summary: 酒店预订、入住、比较选择和处理问题。
objectives: Check in and ask what is included
Report problems and arrange luggage storage

vocabulary.example: Is a twin room available?
Do I need to pay a deposit?
The room at the back is quieter.

listening.title: Booking a Room
listening.transcript: We have a double room on Friday and Saturday. A twin room is only available on Saturday. Breakfast costs eight pounds per guest.

questions.q: When is the twin room available?

speaking.prompt: 打电话订两晚，问双床房、费用和早餐。
speaking.sample: Do you have a twin room for two nights? Is breakfast included?

reading.title: 查询房型、空房与价格
reading.text: River Hotel lists a double room with one large bed and a twin room with two beds. The room rate includes Wi-Fi, but breakfast is a separate charge.

writing.prompt: 写一封 60–75 词的订房询问，包含人数、日期、房型和两个问题。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（Is there ...?；Do you have ... available?）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Available 作形容词，表示可订。
quiz.prompt: Is there a room ___ on Friday?

quiz.explanation: available 在本课中指可订的。
quiz.prompt: What does “available” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Checking In
lessons.subtitle: 前台核对预订与入住须知
grammar: under the name ...；Do I need to ...?

vocabulary.example: Do I need to pay a deposit?
The room at the back is quieter.

listening.title: Checking In
listening.transcript: Welcome. I have your booking under Chen for two nights. Please show your passport. Breakfast is on the ground floor from seven to ten.

speaking.prompt: 扮演入住旅客，报姓名和住几晚，询问早餐和押金。
speaking.sample: I have a booking under Chen for two nights. Do I need to pay a deposit?

reading.title: 前台核对预订与入住须知
reading.text: Check-in starts at 3 p.m. A refundable deposit is required at check-in. Keep your key card away from your phone and return it before leaving.

questions.q: When do guests pay the deposit?

writing.prompt: 写一条消息给同住人，转述入住信息、早餐时段和退房须知。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（under the name ...；Do I need to ...?）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Under the name 表示以某人名义预订。
quiz.prompt: I have a booking ___ the name Chen.

lessons.title: Which Room Is Better?
lessons.subtitle: 比较价格、噪声和位置
grammar: 比较级 + than；more + 多音节形容词

vocabulary.example: The room at the back is quieter.
Do I need to pay a deposit?
Is a twin room available?

listening.title: Which Room Is Better?
listening.transcript: The street room is cheaper, but it’s noisier. The garden room is twenty pounds more per night. It’s quieter and has a bigger bathroom.

questions.q: Which room has a bigger bathroom?

speaking.prompt: 比较两个房型，用两句比较级解释选择。
speaking.sample: The garden room is quieter, but the street room is cheaper. I’d choose the garden room.

reading.title: 比较价格、噪声和位置
reading.text: Hotel A costs £65 and is a five-minute walk from the station. Hotel B costs £55 and is a twenty-minute walk away. Both have free Wi-Fi.

questions.q: Which hotel is closer to the station?

writing.prompt: 写 65–80 词比较两个住宿选择，给出两条理由。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（比较级 + than；more + 多音节形容词）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: 比较级后用 than 引出比较对象。
quiz.prompt: The garden room is quieter ___ the street room.

quiz.explanation: quiet 在本课中指安静的。
quiz.prompt: What does “quiet” mean in this lesson?

grammar: isn’t working 描述当前故障；Could someone ...?

listening.title: The Air Conditioning Isn’t Working
listening.transcript: This is room 308. The air conditioning isn’t working, and the room is very warm. Could someone take a look before six? We’re going out at six thirty.

speaking.prompt: 向前台报告一个故障，给房号、问题、紧急程度和希望处理的时间。
speaking.sample: I’m in room 308. The air conditioning isn’t working. Could someone look at it before six?

reading.title: 说清房间问题并请求处理
reading.text: For problems after 10 p.m., call reception from your room. Describe the issue and give your room number. If there is a leak, please turn off the tap if you can.

writing.prompt: 写 65–80 词给前台反映问题，明确希望维修还是换房。

listening.title: Is Breakfast Included?
listening.transcript: Breakfast is included with your booking. Parking costs twelve pounds per night. You can use the hotel gym for free with your room key.

questions.q: Which service has an extra charge?

speaking.prompt: 向酒店确认三项服务是否收费，并复述额外费用。
speaking.sample: Is breakfast included? How much extra is parking for two nights?

reading.title: 核对费用与服务
reading.text: Your booking includes breakfast for two, free Wi-Fi and late checkout at noon. Airport pickup is available for £25 per room. Please book it at least one day ahead.

questions.q: How much is airport pickup for one room?

writing.prompt: 写 60–75 词为旅伴总结包含的服务和待支付费用。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（included in ...；How much extra ...?）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Included in 表示包含在某个价格或套餐中。
quiz.prompt: Breakfast is included ___ the room price.

quiz.explanation: included 在本课中指包含在内。
quiz.prompt: What does “included” mean in this lesson?

vocabulary.example: Can we leave our luggage here?
Wi-Fi is included in the price.
There’s a leak under the sink.

listening.title: Can You Keep Our Bags?
listening.transcript: Our train leaves at seven. Can we leave our bags here after checkout? Certainly. Keep this ticket and show it to us when you pick them up.

questions.q: What must the guest show at pickup?

speaking.prompt: 办理退房，说明几点取行李并问清凭证。
speaking.sample: Could you keep our bags until six? What do we need to show when we pick them up?

reading.title: 退房、寄存和取行李
reading.text: Checkout is at eleven. Luggage storage is free until eight in the evening. Keep valuables with you and collect bags from reception, not from the luggage room.

writing.prompt: 写 60–75 词告诉旅伴何时退房、如何寄存和去哪取。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（Could you keep ... until ...?；pick ... up）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Until 表示寄存延续到六点。
quiz.prompt: Could you keep our bags ___ six?

grammar: 比较级与礼貌请求综合

Can we leave our luggage here?

listening.title: Weekly Challenge: Handle a Hotel Stay
listening.transcript: The quiet room costs fifteen pounds more. It’s free tomorrow, but tonight we can offer a room away from the lift at the same price. Would that help?

questions.q: What can the hotel offer tonight?
options: A room away from the lift
questions.answer: A room away from the lift

speaking.prompt: 从旅客角度礼貌说明噪音问题，比较两种方案并明确接受哪一个。
speaking.sample: The room by the lift is noisy. Could we move to the room away from the lift tonight?

reading.title: 整合比较、入住和解决投诉
reading.text: Booking summary: two nights in a street-facing double room. Breakfast included, parking £10 per night. Guests can change rooms subject to availability. Checkout is 11 a.m.
